asked.item: channel verified and in good standing

verdict.reason: The YouTube FAQ says an account connected before verification or before thumbnail support needs to be re-connected, and it lists the reconnect steps.

steps.text: If you connected your YouTube account before custom thumbnail support was added, or you verified your account after you first connected it to Blotato, you'll need to re-connect your account.
To re-connect, go to Settings, then click "Connect account > YouTube" or click the "Reconnect" button on your YouTube account.
Custom thumbnails require a verified YouTube account with custom thumbnail capabilities enabled on YouTube.
